purpose: Narrow byte-bound execution contract for the already-signed BasinCycle Stage-B 6x6 pilot. It fills only mechanical runner details and does not change the scientific roster, plan, architecture, loss, inference selector, gates or claims.

artifacts.one_run_guard: the three bound output directories must not exist before their phase; an interrupted fit cannot resume and a second fit cannot choose another output path

data.preload_policy: read each source image exactly once into a uint8 24x24 tile canvas; crop and corrupt from the cached canvas

tile_identity_contract.canonical_clean_crop_order: 6x6 raster order before the row-local shuffle
tile_identity_contract.truth_layout: argsort(input_identity_order), mapping raster slot to shuffled input tile identity
tile_identity_contract.model_input: the 36 corrupted original upright crop tiles in input identity order
tile_identity_contract.output: strict integer permutation of those same 36 original upright tile identities

pixel_recipe_binding.numeric_domain: float32 RGB clipped to [0,1] after the complete recipe
pixel_recipe_binding.gaussian_poisson: per-tile poisson peak uniform[8,64] followed by independent Gaussian sigma uniform[0,0.18]
pixel_recipe_binding.gaussian_blur: per-tile scipy Gaussian sigma uniform[0.2,1.6], reflect boundary
pixel_recipe_binding.motion_blur: per-tile horizontal or vertical uniform kernel length in {3,5,7}, reflect boundary
pixel_recipe_binding.jpeg_ringing: per-tile Pillow JPEG RGB quality integer[20,95], 4:2:0 subsampling, optimize=false
pixel_recipe_binding.scale_bias_chroma: per-tile per-channel RGB scale uniform[0.65,1.35] plus bias uniform[-0.2,0.2], then chroma around BT.709 luma scale uniform[0.7,1.3]
pixel_recipe_binding.edge_erosion: per-tile width integer[0,2], border blended by alpha uniform[0.35,0.85] toward the remaining interior RGB mean
pixel_recipe_binding.mixed_two_stage: two distinct recipes uniformly sampled without replacement from the six primitive recipes, each with a frozen derived seed

procedural_state_binding.short_tile_cycle: each action is one uniformly sampled 2- or 3-cycle of distinct raster positions
procedural_state_binding.congruent_patch_cycle: each action swaps two non-overlapping congruent raster patches of independently sampled height/width in {1,2}
procedural_state_binding.wrong_edge_weld_cycle: each action is one 3-cycle through a random anchor, one physical neighbour and one distinct third raster position
procedural_state_binding.band_cyclic_roll: each action cyclically rolls one random row or column by a nonzero shift
procedural_state_binding.whole_board_roll: each action cyclically rolls the full 6x6 board by a sampled 2-D shift; (0,0) is replaced by (0,1)
procedural_state_binding.strictness: assert sorted(layout)==arange(36) after the complete state recipe

boundary_auxiliary_target.first_three_channels: mean clean RGB over the corresponding width-four boundary strip at each tangent coordinate
boundary_auxiliary_target.last_three_channels: forward tangent difference of those three RGB values; tangent index zero is exactly zero
boundary_auxiliary_target.use: fit-only Charbonnier auxiliary; never rendered or emitted

execution.corruption_parallelism: row-local deterministic ThreadPool with ordered map; random streams depend only on frozen row seeds
execution.socket_batching: one frozen SocketMatcher forward over all solver-replay rows in each model batch, followed by deterministic CPU decoding
execution.stage_b_batching: one batch-four forward/backward per frozen fit update and batch-four forward during target-free freeze
execution.known_sync_bottleneck: each Stage-B forward intentionally detaches pair logits to CPU for deterministic top-k/cycle closure, then returns the frozen bank to the model device; this architecture-level MPS-to-CPU synchronization is not removed by the runner

reported: fraction of states with a positive-pair proposal
fraction whose positive mask includes KEEP
complete 14910-action 2/3-cycle oracle comparison for the first fixed row
fit_diagnostics.purpose: detect random-initialisation proposal-bank starvation or collapse without looking at EVAL32

freeze.bundle_format: compressed NPZ with allow_pickle=false-compatible numeric arrays only
persisted: action logits, quantiles and risk logits
fixed selected action and strict selected layout

source_clustered_bootstrap.cluster: reserved source filename retaining its two fixed draws

metrics: pair nonworsening fraction and worst case
score.gates: exactly those in the scientific config
